The new expiration date of the credit facility is april 26, 2011. The available funding under the credit facility will remain at $ 2500000 through april 27, 2010 and then decrease to $ 2000000 during the final year of the credit facility agreement. Other terms and conditions in the credit facility remain unchanged.
